tools.name: apply_listing_filter
tools.description: Apply one exact visible filter value using the same in-page navigation as a shopper.

tools.name: apply_listing_sort
tools.description: Apply one exact sorting option currently rendered on this BestPrice listing page.

tools.name: clear_listing_filters
tools.description: Clear the filters currently applied to this BestPrice search or category page.

tools.name: compare_page_offers
tools.description: Compare up to four currently rendered offers by item price, shipping, delivered price, availability, and merchant rating.

limit.description: Number of lowest-delivered-price offers to return, from 1 to 4.

tools.name: get_listing_filters
tools.description: Return the selected and available values from filters currently rendered on this listing page.

tools.name: get_listing_sort_options
tools.description: Return the sorting options currently rendered on this BestPrice listing page.

tools.name: get_page_product
tools.description: Return the product, current minimum price, rating, and offer count shown on this BestPrice item page.

tools.name: get_product_specifications
tools.description: Return structured specifications for the product on this BestPrice item page, optionally focused on one specification section.

section.description: Specification section to return. Use all for a concise overview.

limit.description: Maximum number of specification facts to return, from 1 to 16.

tools.name: get_visible_products
tools.description: Return up to eight products currently rendered on this BestPrice search or category page.

tools.name: search_bestprice
tools.description: Start a BestPrice product search and navigate this browser tab to the results.

query.description: Product, brand, model, or shopping need to search for.

tools.name: show_price_history
tools.description: Open or focus the price-history chart for the product currently shown on the BestPrice item page.

tools.name: summarize_price_history
tools.description: Return the current, lowest, and highest recorded prices plus recent and overall price direction for this BestPrice product.
